name: fac-pre-work-invitation
description: Drafts everything sent before a session, producing a short invitation, one small "come with" ask or an honest "no preparation needed", a pre-read condensed from your own material, a reminder and the facilitation team's messages. Use for "run fac-pre-work-invitation", "workshop invitation email", "training invitation", "pre-work for a workshop", "write the pre-read", "reminder before the training", "nobody opens the pre-read", "brief my co-facilitators", part of the Claude for Trainers and Facilitators Pack by 90n.
